title: Dynamic Intake: Risk-Weighted Routing & SLA Automation for Security and Privacy Requests
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Goal: Build a risk-weighted intake and routing automation that classifies incoming customer security/privacy requests (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR/DPA/vendor questionnaires) and assigns an SLA, required artifact checklist, and the appropriate owner (security, legal, solutions, account exec) with minimal manual triage.

Scope:
- In-scope: inbound questionnaire submissions, email intake from sales/support, portal intake forms, and uploaded artifacts.
- Out-of-scope: active incident response, regulatory investigations, or third-party audits (handled via separate processes).

Success metrics (first 90 days):
- Reduce manual triage time per request by 60% (baseline: ~45min).
- 80% of requests automatically routed to the correct owner without manual reassignment.
- SLA compliance for enterprise requests (P0/P1) at >=95% after rollout.
- False-positive escalations <=10% (requests routed to security/legal unnecessarily).

Approach:
1) Define a risk score model composed of attributes: customer tier (enterprise/standard), data sensitivity (PHI/PII/none), requested control type (audit report, DPA, SOC2 evidence, architecture diagram), legal jurisdiction (GDPR relevance), timeline urgency, and historical request patterns. Weighting will be configurable via Console.
2) Implement a shadow mode scoring service (ENG dependency) that consumes intake events and returns a score + recommended route and SLA. Run in parallel for 2 weeks to validate decisions against human triage.
3) Build an SLA & artifact matrix mapping score bands to SLA targets (P0: 24h, P1: 7d, P2: 21d...) and a minimal artifact checklist (e.g., SOC2 cert + relevant control mapping).
4) Expose a lightweight routing UI in Console for reviewers to override and record rationale. Capture these overrides to refine scoring (ML assisted over time).
5) Add audit logging to support post-hoc audits and to feed compliance dashboards.

Technical considerations:
- Intake sources: support email -> Zendesk webhook (ENG-4921), portal form -> Intake API, shared Drive uploads.
- Data minimization: store only metadata and links to artifacts; any sensitive attachments go into encrypted storage (KMS) with restricted access.
- Interop with existing rollout/fallback policies: requests routed to Dedicated/Private customers must respect tenancy and access controls.

Rollout plan:
- Week 1-2: Define scoring weights with Security, Legal, Sales; build PRD and matrix.
- Week 3-4: Shadow mode (no automated routing) for intake streams from 3 pilot accounts, collect data.
- Week 5: Analysis and tuning; add Console override UI for pilot reviewers.
- Week 6-7: Canary automated routing for pilot accounts with human-in-loop confirmation on P0/P1.
- Week 8+: Gradual ramp and full release, accompanied by a playbook and internal training.
